headline: Tenda Shares Fall 17.7% Following Weak Third Quarter Results
summary: Shares of Brazilian homebuilder Tenda dropped 17.7% after the company reported a 48.7% decline in net profit for the third quarter of 2026, missing market expectations.
why: Tenda is a significant player in the Brazilian low-income housing market. Weak results in this sector can signal broader challenges in construction costs or consumer demand for housing.

impacts.name: Tenda
impacts.why: Poor earnings performance directly leads to a decline in share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The significant drop in profit compared to the previous year and market expectations triggered a negative investor reaction.
